reason: The premise that Hf suppresses precipitates is supported by E2's report on W29Ta42Cr5V16Hf8, but the proposed mechanism (increased lattice distortion reducing Cr/V diffusivity) is not directly evidenced in the cited passages, and the claim about maintained manufacturability lacks specific support.
premises: Hf addition increases lattice distortion and reduces Cr/V diffusivity
Reduced Cr/V diffusivity suppresses precipitate nucleation at grain boundaries
W29Ta42Cr5V16Hf8 showed no precipitates at 10 dpa
Partial Cr substitution by Hf maintains high melting temperature and manufacturability
Unmodified W38Ta36Cr15V11 develops Cr-V-rich precipitates at ~8 dpa
